cohort: Mothers positive for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) with HBV DNA levels ≥6 log copies/mL who were treated with TDF during pregnancy
finding: The use of TDF in pregnancy reduced maternal HBV DNA levels and was well tolerated.
mod_finding: There were five (22.7 %) preterm deliveries and five (22.7 %) cesarean deliveries.
